LlamaIndex API.PORT: HTTP routing port; one Uvicorn worker listens here.
LlamaIndex API.DATABASE_URL: Private PostgreSQL connection for DBOS runtime, workflow store, events and demo ledger.
LlamaIndex API.API_TOKEN: Generated bearer secret protecting all run, event, debugger and documentation routes.
LlamaIndex API.DBOS_EXECUTOR_PREFIX: Permanent single-slot executor lease prefix; do not change while runs are pending.
LlamaIndex API.PROPOSAL_MODE: deterministic (no external call) or openai (requires a separately supplied OPENAI_API_KEY).
LlamaIndex API.OPENAI_MODEL: Hosted proposal model; used only in openai mode and incurs provider charges.
LlamaIndex API.OPENAI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: Bounded hosted-model request timeout from 1 to 120 seconds.

Postgres.PORT: Private PostgreSQL listener; never add a public TCP proxy.
Postgres.POSTGRES_USER: Dedicated database owner used for DBOS and LlamaIndex migrations.
Postgres.POSTGRES_DB: Dedicated workflow database, including requests, approvals and ledger.
Postgres.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generated database password referenced privately by the API.
Postgres.PGDATA: Database files inside the persistent PostgreSQL volume.
